plugin.name: Activity Link Preview For BuddyPress
plugin.architecture: single-file procedural; no classes, no namespace (1185 lines, 22 functions)
plugin.requires: BuddyPress OR BuddyBoss Platform (auto-deactivates if neither active). Plugin header: Requires at least WP 5.9, Requires PHP 7.4.
plugin.header_version_vs_branch_note: Plugin header (:8) + BP_ACTIVITY_LINK_PREVIEW_VERSION (:28) + readme Stable tag + package.json all say 1.7.4, matching the v1.7.4 dev branch.

rest.namespace: consumes BuddyPress REST (buddypress/v1) — registers no routes of its own

endpoints.purpose: Embeds bp_activity_link (:1142) into every activity REST response, plus bp_activity_comment_link (:1146-1147) when the activity type is activity_comment. Not an own route — a filter on BP's response. Registered at :108, handler defined at :1140.

ajax.auth_model: logged-in gate (:200-202) + nonce (:205-207) + SSRF guard (:224 via bp_activity_link_preview_is_blocked_host)
ajax.purpose: Fetches Open Graph / oEmbed preview data for a URL typed in the activity composer. Returns title/description/images JSON. Registered at :93, handler defined at :198.

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_preview_load_assets
hooks_fired.purpose: Override whether the plugin's CSS/JS are enqueued on the current request (return value of bp_activity_link_preview_should_load_assets, :134).

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_parse_url_preview
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the parsed preview payload returned by the AJAX handler before JSON output.

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_parse_url_shorten_url_provider
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the list of short-URL host providers that trigger redirect resolution (bit.ly, snip.ly, rb.gy, tinyurl.com, tiny.one, rotf.lol, b.link, 4ubr.short.gy).

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_parse_url
hooks_fired.purpose: Filter the final parsed URL data. Fired on every return path: cached-only miss (:350), internal-URL hit (:371), internal-URL miss (:374), oEmbed hit (:407), external-scrape path (:545).

hooks_fired.name: bp_oembed_discover_support
hooks_fired.purpose: Toggle oEmbed discovery for a given URL (default false).

hooks_fired.name: bp_activity_link_preview_enable_comments
hooks_fired.purpose: Master switch (default true) for comment link previews. Read in the save paths (:745 posted-field branch, :778 content-scrape branch), the comment render filter (:935), and the conditional filter registration (:998). Usage examples documented at :1169-1180.

hooks_consumed.name: plugins_loaded
hooks_consumed.purpose: Bootstrap after BP loads (BP uses default 10).

hooks_consumed.name: admin_notices
hooks_consumed.purpose: Dependency-missing notice (registered from the deactivation guard and from the plugins_loaded closure).

hooks_consumed.name: wp_enqueue_scripts
hooks_consumed.purpose: Enqueue CSS/JS + dashicons + Twitter + Facebook SDK + localized data (gated by bp_activity_link_preview_should_load_assets).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_init
hooks_consumed.purpose: Remove BuddyBoss's own link preview filter to avoid duplicates (remove_filter at :193).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_init
hooks_consumed.purpose: Register comment-content filter when comment previews enabled.

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_after_save
hooks_consumed.purpose: Persist preview data to activity meta on save (handler at :703).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_get_activity_content_body
hooks_consumed.purpose: Append rendered preview to activity content body (handler at :868).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_comment_content
hooks_consumed.purpose: Append rendered preview to comment content (conditionally registered inside bp_activity_link_preview_init_comment_filter; handler at :933).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_activity_allowed_tags
hooks_consumed.purpose: Allow div/img/button/span/i/iframe markup in activity content for previews (handler at :1076).

hooks_consumed.name: bp_rest_activity_prepare_value
hooks_consumed.purpose: Embed preview meta into BP REST activity response (handler at :1140).

hooks_consumed.name: wp_head
hooks_consumed.purpose: Output #fb-root div on BP activity/group/user pages for Facebook SDK (handler at :1156).

activity_meta.purpose: Preview payload (url, title, description, image_url) for main activity posts. Written :741; read :919, :1141.
Preview payload for activity comments. Written :777, :799, :983; read :955, :1146.

caching.ttl: DAY_IN_SECONDS (success); 15 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS for the 'bpalp_failed' negative-cache sentinel
caching.purpose: Cache parsed URL preview data per-URL for 24h; failed parses are negative-cached for 15 minutes to avoid refetch storms.

js_only_activation.note: Composer-time preview UI is JS-only by nature (live URL detection as user types). Render of SAVED previews on read is PHP-side (bp_get_activity_content_body filter), so persisted previews show with JS off. Acceptable.

phpcs_excludes.action: Inline suppressions at line 211 (phpcs:ignore ValidatedSanitizedInput — URL validated with FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) and the 704-805 region (phpcs:disable/enable NonceVerification.Missing — nonce handled by BuddyPress before bp_activity_after_save fires). Both justified with comments.

buddypress_integration.compat_notes: Detects and stands down for BuddyBoss native link preview (:192-193, :875) and Youzify wall URL preview (:886-895 — checks YOUZIFY_VERSION/Youzify class, the youzify_enable_wall_url_preview option, and the 'url_preview' activity meta) to avoid duplicate cards. BuddyBoss JWT (bb-preview-token, :422) used for same-site private-network scrapes. Youzify stand-down is server-side in the render path only — no Youzify flags are localized to JS.

localized.note: Only the keys the frontend script actually reads are localized (see comment at :170-171). enable_comments, buddyboss_active, youzify_active, and youzify_url_preview_active were removed in the 2026-07-09 orphan-key cleanup — comment gating and Youzify stand-down are server-side decisions.

security.ssrf_guard: AJAX handler calls bp_activity_link_preview_is_blocked_host($host) at :224 before any fetch. Helper (:258-278) blocks empty host, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP private/reserved ranges, 127.0.0.1, localhost, and the 10./172.16-31./192.168. CIDRs.
security.url_validation: FILTER_VALIDATE_URL on input (:211) and on resolved redirect targets
security.remote_fetch: wp_safe_remote_get for page scrapes (:296, :436); wp_safe_remote_head + wp_remote_retrieve_header('location') (:317-329) for short-URL redirect resolution. No raw file_get_contents anywhere — the pre-1.7.4 file_get_contents fallback was removed in 1.7.4.
security.output_escaping: esc_attr/esc_url/esc_html in render (bp_activity_link_preview_render_preview, :1011); oEmbed/embed code passed through (trusted WP oEmbed)
